title: Red Hat Security Advisory: gdb security update
description: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability exists in the GNU Debugger (GDB) STABS parser function read_member_functions() when processing crafted ELF files. This flaw is identified as CVE-2026-13732 and affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.2 Update Services for SAP Solutions and Extended Life Cycle variants. The issue could allow an attacker to cause memory corruption via a specially crafted ELF file. Red Hat has released an important security update to address this vulnerability.
